summary: You stay in control of rights: nothing is taken away unless you decide.

new.title: New Optional components page
new.text: Administration > Optional components shows each optional part, whether it is on, which rights it lacks and the script that adds exactly those. The page only reads.

new.title: One script per component
new.text: New scripts add the rights for user tagging, device tagging and Exchange one at a time. Each can show what it would add first, without changing anything.

new.title: Hybrid worker AD step completes itself
new.text: The Hybrid worker confirms its Active Directory rights by itself, and the step clears once they are in place. Nobody has to mark it done.

fixes.title: Rights are never removed automatically
fixes.text: Turning a feature off no longer takes its rights away; the install marks them as not needed and keeps them. You remove a right only when you choose to.

fixes.title: No false Tamper alerts for own changes
fixes.text: Tamper no longer raises false alerts for Entra Policy Suite's own tag changes.
